2026.1.0: Pascoal is here! This first release includes a guided Free Pascal installer, automatic updates, and a Pascal editor built for learning.
2026.1.1: Improved syntax highlighting: types, functions, and variables are now recognized correctly, powered by a real Pascal parser.
2026.2.0: You'll now see a short summary of what's new right after each update - and can revisit it anytime from Help > Release Notes.
2026.2.1: You can now browse the full version history from Help > Version History, and update notifications show the same friendly notes as What's new.
2026.3.0: A new Settings panel has arrived - pick your theme and language, set up your git identity without a terminal, and check your Free Pascal and git installation, all in one place.
2026.4.0: You can now create, rename, delete, and cut/copy/paste files and folders right in the Explorer, and a new Edit menu adds Find in Files, Toggle Line Comment, and more to the menu bar.
